nom: Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Face Lotion with Soothing Prebiotic Oat

avis.texte: Perfect, lightweight and great value for my money. No spf in it though. Bottle size is a bit larger than the version with spf 15. Not greasy and super moisturizing. It’ll last a lot longer though

Very nice face lotion, nice and light and I do feel it's very effective in brightening my (older) complexion. I use it with the companion face wash and night cream. I try others now and then for variety but find I always go back to Aveeno. And the price is very reasonable.

avis.titre: Nice sensitive lotion, packaging not so great
avis.texte: Aveeno facial lotion works beautifully on my sensitive skin but the packaging is messy and wasteful. It’s very lightweight (definitely a good thing) but it pours right out of the tube. Since I like the lotion and the price is very reasonable, I’m still using it. I’ve found that holding the tube cap-side-up and letting the lotion settle away from the top allows me to open the cap without the mess. Usually. Hopefully they update the packaging.

avis.titre: Love it! Been using it for yearsLove it! Been using it for years
avis.texte: Perfect daily moisturizer. I have very sensitive skin doesn't break me out. it's a great value, no fragrances.

avis.titre: Excellent product goes a long way!
avis.texte: I had always used Olay, but find this is even better for moisture and being non greasy feeling. A very tiny amount does the face and neck. Leftovers have gone on the body and improved that skin as well!

avis.titre: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Perfect Daily Hydration! Lightweight, Deeply Soothing & Unscented
avis.texte: If you need a gentle, incredibly reliable facial moisturizer that locks in deep hydration without clogging your pores, Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Face Lotion is a top-tier choice. It provides professional-grade nourishment at an affordable, drugstore price point.Here are the key points that make this facial lotion a five-star buy on Amazon:Soothes with Prebiotic Oat: Infused with pure, nourishing prebiotic oat, it instantly calms redness, tightens dry skin patches, and intensely strengthens your skin’s natural moisture barrier.Clinically Proven 24-Hour Hydration: You only need a single daily application. It absorbs incredibly fast to keep normal, dry, or highly sensitive skin feeling soft and beautifully smooth from morning until night.Ultra-Lightweight & Non-Greasy: Unlike heavy body creams that leave a sticky residue, this facial formula is designed specifically for the face and neck. It sinks right in with a weightless, matte finish that layers perfectly under daily sunscreen or makeup.100% Sensitive Skin Safe: It is completely fragrance-free, oil-free, non-comedogenic, and contains absolutely zero parabens, dyes, or harsh alcohols. It provides smooth healing without causing breakouts or burning irritated skin.It leaves your complexion looking visibly radiant and naturally healthy-looking with zero greasy shine. It is the ultimate addition to any minimalist skincare routine!

I have sensitive skin that’s tends to be dry. This product works well for me. It moisturizes without feeling greasy. The value for this moisturizer is good and the tube is easy to use. I recommend this product. Thank you.

literally my #1 essential! i apply this every day, especially before doing my makeup. i have super dry and sensitive skin, and this definitely helps keep my face hydrated. it also lasts me quite a while since i only use about a pea-sized amount each time. i love aveeno!

avis.titre: Que la compren vale lo que pagas x ella
avis.texte: Me sorprendió la crema para el rostro super fluida al momento que te la pones en el rostro muy ligera y te queda el rostro super terso y suave
Fragrance free and I like the bottle it’s so cute travel size .

avis.titre: Suave y ligera para piel sensibles, actúa de manera eficaz y sin fragancia
avis.texte: Me encanta esta crema , la verdad me deja la piel bien hidratada. Es súper suave y ligero para la piel sensible y actúa de una manera eficaz, haciendo un excelente trabajo sin irritarte y me encanta que sea además sin fragancia ah y olvidaba algo No te deja la piel grasosa.

avis.titre: Es para todo tipo de piel
avis.texte: Me ha gustado mucho esta crema. Es ligera, se absorbe rápido y deja la piel hidratada sin sensación grasosa. Además, no tiene fragancia y resulta muy agradable para el uso diario. La recomiendo.
I bought this for my husband and he’s been really good at using it every night and he says it’s not heavy and doesn’t have a smell so he does t mind using it

avis.titre: Great quality and value for the price.
avis.texte: Product arrived on time and in great condition. Pump was easy to unlock and moisturizer is smooth/ light and easily absorbed. Fragrance free and great quality and value for the price.
Product is great. Needs better packaging. Lotion came open and a little spilled out

I like this lotion. It’s light and feels nice on my skin. It helps keep my skin soft and calm all day. It doesn’t feel sticky or oily. I use it every day, and it’s good for my sensitive skin. I will keep using it

avis.titre: A lot of product but watery
avis.texte: I like that there is a lot of product in the container but the consistency is watery. It’s ok and gets the job done but I don’t love it.

No me fije pero según no es la q pedí el tapón sale café esta es verde. Pero igual me quedaré con esa tras q tuve problemas con el envío 📦 Mi piel es muy seca y se me enrojece por eso pedí por q vi q tenía buenos comentarios q era hidratante y esta pues no lo es se seca al instante y siento más reseca la cara ☹️😩
Great cream, moisturizes all day long, no smell and no allergies! Great!
This is the first time I am writing a review. This item arrived used. It was clearly used, and I had to buy a box to return it. Do not waste your money.

Not for sensitive skin I had a tingling sensation when I applied it, too. It didn't seal in a bit. And it doesn't moisturize as expected even though it's already spring. It might be better to wait until the summer when your face gets oily, but you definitely can't use it in the winter time. Also, you can see from the picture that the texture is very thin, more like a lotion than a cream.

avis.titre: Arrived sticky and dirty and gross.
avis.texte: Received a product that had zero safety features. The outside was sticky and dirty. Opened it and there wasn’t a safety seal. When you order a product designed to put on your face, you want it to arrive looking clean. I’m surprised someone did t care and just stuck it in the box. It looks like either mine or the lotion next to it exploded and nobody bothered to clean the others.
No se que paso pero mi paquete llegó abierto y todo derramado
Wanted to purchase this for dry skin, but made it worse. Now it's dry and red! First thought it's me, maybe I'm allergic or something else but my wife used and she has the same symptoms.

I’ve been using Aveeno for a long time, but I always ordered from either Walgreens or Walmart and never had a problem. This time I ordered from here, and the sense of the lotion smelled horrible, like it's expired for 2 years!! No! I returned it.

I like most Aveeno products and decided to give this a try. It works ok but is a lot thinner than I thought it would be. If I’m not careful when opening, it just pours right out. It feels thin on my face and not very hydrated like it claims.

avis.titre: Tube is fragile and not sealed
avis.texte: Item arrived like this. Consistency also seems off (purchased in store for years). Won't be ordering it off Amazon again, at least nothing that is in a similar squeeze tube.

avis.titre: It’s light weight but I don’t like the smell
avis.texte: This is a nice moisturizer for the face (or body). It’s lightweight, non greasy, and absorbs well into the skin. I’ve never had any irritation, redness, or reactions to this product. I can’t stand the smell though. To me it smells faintly of a mix between plain yogurt and oats. It’s not a fragranced delicious sweet flavored yogurt you want to devour. Maybe more like sour cream. It’s slightly soured yogurt oats. I’m sure this is the prebiotic part in the title giving it this smell. Since I didn’t like the smell I stopped using it on my face (get it away from my nose!!) and tried using it on my arms after showering when they feel super dry (soft water system). It was nice for that, and the smell is less strong that far away. I also used this on my moist/just showered skin so a little product went a long way. I did this probably about a week or so before I just decided it’s not for me. Pros: Gentle moisture Another reliable sensitivity skin product by Aveeno Probiotics have good benefits for skin application Cons: Probiotics are stinky

Aveeno always puts out great product and this is no different, however, I find the packaging to be a bit descriptive, hence, the 4 stars. Please see my picture up against light. I did not weigh this product since there is no telling how much the package weighs so I am going to assume that there is actually 5 ounces of product, but the container could reflect that better. I am that person that is unhappy with the inch taken away from the size of my toilet paper rolls when they advertise more sheets and charge more. The cream is smooth and has kept my hand, not face, moisturized all day. From experience, I test every new facial product on my hands before I put it on my face to avoid reactions. I have a keen sense of smell and although this says fragrance free, I do smell the base product, but it fades in time. Nothing too strong or something to be concerned with. Overall, I would recommend this product from Aveeno.

A 5 ounce tube of face cream that is moisturizing but doesn't leave my skin shiny or greasy looking. It has no fragrance added and the very very faint scent is pleasant. Unfortunately, it does not have a SPF rating. Although called a face cream, the actual product is thinner than a cream - it has a lotion-like consistency. It was absorbed very quickly and left my skin feeling great. I would have rated it with 5 stars except for: 1. It has no safety seal. I prefer products that are sealed somehow. 2. It has no SPF rating. While I understand some people don't want sun protection or have sensitivities to ingredients that protect the skin from sun exposure, a face cream that is called "Daily Moisturizing" seems like it should have some sun protection. With no sun protection this is a cream that I will only use overnight.

avis.titre: Ideal for My Normal-to-Dry, Sensitive Face
avis.texte: This face lotion is perfect for me. I have normal to dry skin that is extremely sensitive. It responds best to fragrance-free products. I love the lightweight nature of this lotion and find the oat content very soothing. While some nights I prefer a thick cream with retinol as an ingredient, there are other nights — such as after dermaplaning or exfoliating — that I just want a plain moisturizer. This lotion also will serve me well during the day but I need to add a layer of sunscreen over it. I predict that this value size will last me about a month. I like the pump, which dispenses lotion easily and fits nicely on my bathroom counter or in a drawer. I have long used Aveeno skincare products and they have not yet let me down.

avis.titre: New Packaging But Still A Great Moisturizer
avis.texte: I love the older version of this and was hesitant to buy the newer one because I wasn’t sure if it was the same product. It is! New packaging on the left, old on the right. The formula is slightly different smelling (less oaty, which I liked but many didn’t based off of other reviews) but works great nonetheless. I have rosacea and dry skin so I use this under my makeup for the day and after my shower at night - no pilling and still moisturized in the morning! 10/10

This feels light and has no scent, which I’ve come to expect from Aveeno products. It is gentle on the skin and doesn’t leave my face feeling tacky. Even hours after use my skin feels moisturized. I am very sensitive, so finding products where I feel good and there’s no weird reactions is always a win! The bottle here is value size, so the price is right.
You really can’t ever go wrong with Aveeno! It’s so creamy and moisturizing. The ingredients seem really high quality and there’s no scent. I have really dry skin and this feels amazing.

This is a very light weight and perfect moisturizer for all year round. I cleanse with Aveeno Daily Moisturizing Cleanser and then apply a minimal amount to my face in the morning and night. Doesn’t leave any sticky, residue feeling, instead it quickly absorbs. Price and product are a definite match.👍 (The product is well made, exactly what is advertised and is priced as it should be in MY OPINION.)

Great lightweight moisturizer. A small amount was more than enough for my face and beck. Spreads quickly and absorbs quickly. Did not irritate my rosacea and sensitive skin at all. Perfect for those with sensitive skin and those who need light daily moisturization. Those who have particularly dry skin might want to opt for a heavier more moisturizing cream.
Love aveeno, it has good ingredients and free of artificial scents, great for sensitive skin types or skin with eczema, super hydrating perfect for daily use, could also work as a body or hand cream!

Ave o really knew what they were doing when they made this moisturizing face cream. I leaves my face feeling so hydrated. It doesn’t leave it feeling oily like some moisturizers do. It’s not too strong with a scent either which is great.
My go to face lotion. So smooth you could barely feel it. It makes my skin so soft, it last 24 hours. Fragrance free. Highly recommended
Unscented lightweight face lotion that leaves face feeling super hydrated.
Good face wash, I use it in the morning and my skin feels refresh

I’m dealing with really dry, flaky skin right now & my skin is super sensitive, I did not like the consistency of this product at all, it felt super runny & does not feel moisturizing & as soon as I put it in my face got red. I do however recommend the one for kids, you get more product for less money & you can tell the difference in thickness (the kids is on the left of my hand & on the right is the daily moisturizing face lotion) it feels really nice of the face & did not make me red at all.

very juicy product. Feels like sliding in your skin. Feels moisturizing. Dont know long term effect yet. But the packaging it’s not the proper one for delivery. Lots of product wasted due to bad packaging.

Skin Type: Combination of dry, Oily and PCOS Acne. 3rd time buying this item and will keep returning to aveeno. Non greasy and super absorbant. My rocasea flares up using Cerave but when I returned to Aveeno, its healing fast!

Quick shipping, good price as face moisturizers seem hard to find for a decent price. The bottle is a nice size as well, I may have it for a few months til' it runs out. However, I noticed some weird, brown, sticky residue attached to the body of the bottle. I quickly washed my hands and took a sanitizing wipe to wipe whatever this gross stuff was. On the other hand, the lotion has a fresh oat scent to it which I was pleased to see. I also have eczema so the oat ingredients will be even perfecter against my hands and face for a safe application.

No puedo dar una opinión exacta, ya que solo tengo un día de haberla recibido. Soy de piel sensible y busco cremas hidratantes sin alcohol. Y no leí, antes de la compra que entre sus ingredientes,tiene alcohol. Pero al aplicarla es una crema bastante hidratante. Lo extraño es que viene sin sello debajo de la tapa. Es decir no trajo la película que cierra el orificio de salida. Como un producto nuevo.

I was excited that I was able to order this from Amazon and it was actually a lot cheaper than what I usually pay for it!! My car recently broke down and I wasn't able to get to the store and I am extremely thankful for Amazon!!!
